config.percentile: nearest-rank ceil(n*p), median average of central two when even

timing.clock: performance.now; one contiguous synchronous interval per operation
included: JSON decode, whole-packet validation/admission, transition.finish, effect serialization and report parse for receive
full UTF-16 checksum on returned text
excluded: fresh receiver create/import, history/Version equality checks and pre-mutation text warming
remote sender edits and delta export
Undo paste and pre-Undo text warming
timing.warmState: fresh imported 10k-op receiver per lane per pair, pre-read once before target change; post-change text is first read inside timer
timing.pairing: identical deterministic actor IDs/seed/history/packet and fresh restored receivers; AB/BA alternating; no forced GC; no dropped samples
